title: Creamy Mushroom Tortellini
subtitle: Youfoodz | Ready in 5 | Serves 2 or 4
description: Ready to heat bundles perfect for on-the-go evenings. No prep. No fuss and no washing up. 2 people subscriptions will receive 2 x single serve meals 4 people subscriptions will receive 4 x single serve meals

steps.text:
• 1. Remove cardboard sleeve from tray.
• 2. Peel back the corner of film.
• 3. Microwave on high for 3 mins (or until hot)
• 4. Peel off film completely from tray. Enjoy!
